_what: The DEV export used by the Phase 1 discovery engine. Read-only snapshot of the production database taken 2026-10-21 with research/discovery/export_dev.sql (every statement filters event_date < 2025-01-01). Loader re-checks every row with pred_protocol.dev_only() and the priced subset against holdout_manifest.json DEV fingerprints.
known_limits: BFO consensus carries 1970 placeholder timestamps: opener and closer are ordered, not timed (CLV-001 R-13).
21 DEV fights have no recorded fight totals; they add to records and Elo but not to rate features.
height, reach, stance and dob are present-day profile values treated as fixed (PRED-001 s3 caveat). 77 fighters have no stance, reach is missing for some.
bout_order is empty for every DEV fight; card position is not available.
Fights 43, 46, 8780 (rebooked in place) are H1-era exclusions in PRED-001 and are not in DEV.
